about: Every TrellisWM reference item (T..) and Arbor-only feature (A..), with Arbor's status and the tests and real-window steps that prove it. Statuses: shipped, partial, review (finished on a branch), in-progress, planned (has a spec), missing (no spec yet), not-planned. Priority 1 = core, 2 = important, 3 = nice to have. kind=policy means there is nothing to test. `make parity` turns this into docs/FEATURES.md.

features.title: One 460 ms layout motion
features.trellis: Every split, dock and close animates; camera moves zoom the whole plane
features.arbor: One ease-out of `animationDuration` (0.46 s; 0 or Reduce motion turns it off) for every camera move, dock, float, close, minimize and resize by command. Camera moves zoom the whole plane. A second command carries on from where things are. A correction, when an app had the last word on its frame, ends when the motion was going to. What a motion needs is got ready ahead of time, so the first one after a start begins as promptly as the next. Windows travel as their app's colour and icon, not their contents (T53). Filmed on a Mac at 1.2 s only: that run's 0.46 s session crashed, in the pictures that are now switched off
